hook.text: The average home-service company takes forty-two minutes to call a new lead back. One in four never does. Meet Riley — Riley calls in sixty seconds.

save.text: Qualified, booked, confirmed by text — fifty-eight seconds after the form was submitted.

hot.text: And when a lead is big, Riley doesn't sell — it hands the lead to your closer, warm.

cta.text: Want your leads called in sixty seconds? Let's build it.

call1.speaker: alex
call1.text: Hi Dana, it's Riley from Summit Heating and Air — you just asked about your AC on our website.

call1.speaker: caller
call1.text: No, that's fine. The upstairs is blowing warm air since yesterday.

call1.speaker: alex
call1.text: Got it. I can have a technician out tomorrow at ten AM for a diagnostic and estimate — does that work?

call1.speaker: alex
call1.text: You're booked, Dana. I've texted the confirmation and the tech's name. See you tomorrow.

call2.speaker: caller
call2.text: We're looking at replacing both systems, and we'd want financing.

call2.speaker: alex
call2.text: That's exactly what Mike, our comfort advisor, handles. I've flagged it to him and booked Thursday at two — he'll call you within the hour.
